whois.origin_not_telegram.text: The message's origin is not Telegram; use /whois on messages from the matching platform.

whois.private.text: This user has limited what whois may show.

whois.use_context_menu.text: The slash command cannot determine the message. Use the context menu: right-click the relay message → Apps → whois.

whois.use_reply.text: Use this command as a reply to a bot relay message.

wiki_ev_contentmodel_new.text: {user} created {title} with a non-default content model

wiki_ev_global_other.text: {user} performed a global account action ({action}) on {title}

wiki_ev_newuser_auto.text: an account was created automatically for {target}

wiki_ev_patrol.text: {user} marked a revision of {title} as patrolled

wiki_ev_patrol_auto.text: a revision of {title} was patrolled automatically

wiki_ev_profile.text: {user} changed a profile or comment ({action}) on {title}

wikifeed_attached.text: The wiki {name} ({wiki}) is now attached to {where}. Its activity will be relayed there, including to chats that join later.

wikifeed_chat_only_note.text: This chat is in no bridge yet, so for now the activity arrives here only. Once the chat joins a bridge it goes to every chat of that bridge, and the setting becomes the bridge admins' to manage.

wikifeed_discussions_note.text: Discussions of this wiki are relayed too.

wikifeed_invalid_url.text: That does not look like a link to a wiki. Give the address of any of its pages, its main page, or its api.php.

wikifeed_list_empty.text: No wiki is followed here yet. Add one with /setwikifeed <link to a wiki>.

wikifeed_no_subscription.text: {wiki} is not followed here, so there is nothing to configure.

wikifeed_not_mediawiki.text: No MediaWiki was found at {wiki}. Check the address — the bot only reads MediaWiki sites.

wikifeed_private.text: {wiki} requires an account to read it, so the bot cannot follow it.

wikifeed_rem_usage.text: Usage: /remwikifeed <link to a wiki> — any link to the wiki you want to stop following.

wikifeed_removed.text: Activity from {wiki} is no longer relayed here.

wikifeed_settings_saved.text: Settings for {wiki} updated for every chat of the bridge.

wikifeed_settings_usage.text:
Usage: /wikifeed-settings <link to a wiki> <option>=<value> …
Options: events (a list of types, or all/none), namespaces (numbers, or all), bots (on/off), minor (on/off), format (embed/text), delivery (auto/message), webhook (own/shared).
Example: /wikifeed-settings example.org events=edit,new,delete bots=off webhook=own

wikifeed_throttled.text: {wiki} is rate-limiting the bot or is catching up with its database. Try again in a few minutes.

wikifeed_unknown_namespaces.text: Namespaces are numbers (0 main, 6 File, 14 Category, …). Not numbers: {items}.

wikifeed_unknown_option.text: Unknown option: {items}. Available: events, namespaces, bots, minor, format, delivery, webhook.

wikifeed_unreachable.text: Could not read {wiki}. The wiki may be down or the address may be wrong.

wikifeed_usage.text: Usage: /setwikifeed <link to a wiki> — any page of it, its main page, or its api.php.

ytfeed_attached.text: The YouTube channel {name} ({account}) is now attached to {where}. Its new videos will be relayed there, including to chats that join later.

ytfeed_invalid_channel.text: That is not a YouTube channel. Give an @handle, a link to the channel or a UC… channel id.

ytfeed_rem_usage.text: Usage: /remytfeed <YouTube channel> — an @handle, a link to the channel or a UC… channel id.

ytfeed_removed.text: Videos from {account} are no longer relayed here.

ytfeed_throttled.text: YouTube is rate-limiting the bot right now, so {account} could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.

ytfeed_unreachable.text: Could not read {account}. The channel may be missing or deleted, or YouTube is not answering right now.

ytfeed_usage.text: Usage: /setytfeed <YouTube channel> — an @handle, a link to the channel or a UC… channel id.
